cells.source:
# 01 — Clinical Cohort Ingestion & Schema Validation
Loads raw cohort records, validates non-null partition contracts, and emits a hashed parquet artifact.

import pandas as pd
import pyarrow
import openlineage

df = pd.read_parquet(f"s3://noteops-datasets/raw/{cohort_source}")
assert df.isna().mean().max() <= null_threshold
df.to_parquet("cleaned_cohort.parquet", index=False)

notebooks.name: 02_feature_imputation_knn.ipynb
notebooks.description: Applies deterministic KNN missing-value imputation with configurable neighbor count and seed.

cells.source:
# 02 — Deterministic KNN Feature Imputation
Replaces missing genetic markers using distance-weighted KNN with a fixed random seed for reproducible outputs.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.impute import KNNImputer

np.random.seed(random_seed)
df = pd.read_parquet("cleaned_cohort.parquet")
imputer = KNNImputer(n_neighbors=knn_neighbors, weights=imputer_weights)
imputed = pd.DataFrame(imputer.fit_transform(df.drop(columns=["patient_id"])), columns=df.columns[1:])
imputed.to_parquet("imputed_features.parquet", index=False)

faultTests.injectedFault: Runtime dependency lock mismatch (pip SHA-256 divergence on scikit-learn).
faultTests.expectedSafeBehavior: Detect digest mismatch before step execution, halt silent drift, fall back to pinned OCI container digest.
faultTests.observedDegradedMode: Degraded preflight alert raised; execution paused on drifted worker and re-routed to immutable image digest.
faultTests.recoveryProcedure: Pull pinned image ghcr.io/noteops/notebook-runner:py312-pinned@sha256:9a4e1c, verify lockfile hash, replay cleanly from checkpoint.

faultTests.recoveryProcedure: Reconnect metadata store, flush WAL idempotently by runId+stepId key, confirm 100% lineage completeness.

[DEGRADED] Lineage emitter switched to durable WAL buffering; downstream publish held.
[RECOVERY] Metadata store restored after 2.4s; flushed 4 buffered facets idempotently.
[PASS] Verified 100% lineage completeness with zero duplicate edges or orphaned artifacts.
